require: хотя бы два сложных элемента: придаточное, причастный оборот, инверсия, cleft
связность через linking words и discourse markers

subtopics.name: Past Perfect Continuous (duration before past event)

patterns.pattern: [S] + had been + [V-ing] + [complex object] + for/since + [time] + when + [S] + [V2] + [optional: result]
patterns.generation_hint: Подчеркни длительность до определённого момента в прошлом. Используй for/since.
examples: I had been working on a strategic initiative for more than three months when the board finally approved the budget, and everything went smoothly.
She had been preparing for the certification in project management since January when she realized she needed a completely different approach.

patterns.pattern: By + [future time], [S] + will have been + [V-ing] + [complex object] + for + [duration]
patterns.generation_hint: Используй Future Perfect Continuous для длительности к моменту в будущем.
examples: By next June, I will have been working on international projects for more than five years, and I will have gained invaluable experience.
By the end of the year, she will have been leading the department for three years, and she will have transformed the whole approach.

subtopics.name: Reporting Passive (It is said / He is believed)

patterns.generation_hint: Используй reporting passive для дистанцирования от утверждения.
examples: It is widely believed that the strategic initiative has fundamentally changed the way the company operates.
It was reported that the board of directors had approved the comprehensive restructuring plan before the end of the quarter.
It is generally acknowledged that she has made an outstanding contribution to the field.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй конструкцию 'is said to have done' для передачи чужих утверждений.
examples: The senior management team is believed to have implemented a completely new strategy that transformed the industry.
The client's representative is said to have coordinated the entire project without any external support.

patterns.pattern: [S] + should/must/can/might + have been + [V3] + [optional: by + agent] + [optional: reason]
patterns.generation_hint: Используй модальный пассив для рекомендаций, обязательств или догадок о прошлом.
examples: The proposal should have been reviewed by the committee before the meeting, but it was overlooked.
All the applications must have been submitted by the end of the week because the deadline was strict.
The documents might have been prepared by the research department, but nobody is sure.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй инверсию для эмфазы. Порядок: negative adverbial + aux + subject + verb.
examples: Never have I witnessed such a comprehensive transformation of an entire industry in just a few years.
Rarely had she encountered such a complex strategic challenge, but she handled it brilliantly.
Little did they know that the strategic initiative would fundamentally change the whole company.

patterns.pattern: Not only + [aux] + [S] + [V1] + [complex object], but + [S] + also + [V1] + [complex object]
patterns.generation_hint: Используй Not only ... but also ... для акцента на двух элементах.
examples: Not only did she coordinate the entire international project, but she also mentored three new employees.
Not only have they implemented the strategic initiative, but they have also significantly improved our overall performance.
Not only did he complete the certification, but he also developed a completely new training programme.

patterns.generation_hint: Инверсия в Third Conditional без if. Более формальный стиль.

complex object (condition): the offer when it was on the table

examples: Had I read the client's requirements carefully, I would have avoided all the issues we had.
Had she got her priorities right, she would have completed the whole project on time.
Had they acted on the offer when it was on the table, they would have secured the contract.

patterns.generation_hint: Формальный вариант Second Conditional с инверсией.
examples: Were I to implement this strategy, I would significantly improve our overall performance.
Were she to take on this role, she would bring a completely new perspective to the team.
Were they to invest in this technology, they would gain a considerable competitive advantage.

patterns.generation_hint: Выдели ключевой элемент предложения через it-cleft.
examples: It was the strategic initiative that fundamentally transformed the way we approach our work.
It is her leadership that has inspired the whole team to achieve outstanding results.
It was the mentorship programme that helped me develop the skills I needed for this role.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй wh-cleft для акцента на ключевой идее.
examples: What we really need is a completely new approach, because the old one is no longer effective.
What she appreciates the most is genuine commitment, and that's what makes our team successful.
What they require is a long-term strategy, because short-term solutions are no longer enough.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй present participle для одновременных действий или причин.
examples: Realizing how complex the situation had become, the team decided to completely rethink their approach.
Considering all the available options, the manager recommended a long-term strategy instead of a quick fix.
Noticing the gaps in our current framework, she proposed a comprehensive restructuring plan.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй perfect participle для действия, завершённого до другого.
examples: Having completed the strategic initiative, the team focused on developing a long-term plan for sustainable growth.
Having reviewed all the applications, the committee recommended three candidates for the next stage.
Having coordinated the entire international project, she decided to take on an even more challenging role.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй subjunctive: после этих глаголов идёт базовая форма без -s.
examples: The board recommends that the senior management team implement a comprehensive restructuring plan without delay.
She insisted that the committee prioritize long-term strategy over short-term fixes, because the situation requires it.
They demand that the client's representative attend every meeting, because communication is critical.

patterns.pattern: [S] + was/were going to + [V1] + [complex object] + but + [S] + [V2] + [complex object]
patterns.generation_hint: Используй 'was going to' для планов в прошлом, которые не осуществились.
examples: I was going to implement the strategic initiative last quarter, but the priorities changed completely.
She was going to attend the international conference in Berlin, but the project deadline made it impossible.
They were going to launch the new programme in September, but the budget was cut unexpectedly.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй 'was to' для формальных планов в прошлом.
examples: The board was to approve the comprehensive plan at the next meeting, but the CEO postponed the decision.
She was to lead the international project from January, but the restructuring changed everything.
They were to implement the new system by the end of the year, but technical issues delayed the launch.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй perfect gerund для действий, завершённых до момента речи.
examples: I regret having underestimated the complexity of the strategic initiative, because it cost us a lot of time.
She denied having overlooked the client's requirements, but the evidence suggested otherwise.
They admitted having misunderstood the original objectives, and promised to revise their approach.

patterns.pattern: [S] + expect/want/need + [object] + to be + [V3] + [optional: by + agent] + [optional: time]
patterns.generation_hint: Используй passive infinitive для действий, которые должны быть выполнены кем-то.
examples: We expect the proposal to be reviewed by the committee before the end of the month.
They want the new system to be implemented by a team of independent consultants next quarter.
The company needs all the documents to be submitted by the end of the week.

subtopics.name: The more... the more / The less... the better

patterns.pattern: The more + [S] + [V1] + [complex object], the more + [S] + [V1] + [complex object]
patterns.generation_hint: Используй конструкцию 'the more... the more' для пропорциональной зависимости.

complex object (second): better results in the long run

examples: The more you communicate with international clients, the more confident you become in real conversations.
The more we collaborate with different teams, the more open-minded we become about different perspectives.
The more they practice the language, the better results they achieve in the long run.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй 'no sooner... than' для двух быстро следующих друг за другом действий.
examples: No sooner had she completed the certification than she was offered a much more challenging role.
No sooner had they implemented the new system than they saw a significant improvement in performance.
No sooner had the board approved the plan than the team started working on it.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй wish + would для выражения раздражения или просьбы об изменении.
examples: I wish the manager would stop changing priorities every week, because it makes planning impossible.
She wishes her colleagues would communicate more openly, because the current situation is frustrating.
They wish the client would make a decision soon, because the whole project depends on it.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй эллипсис, чтобы избежать повторения. Используй so/neither/t00/either.
examples: I can implement this strategy, and so can she.
We have completed the certification, and they have too.
She doesn't want to attend the conference, and neither do I.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй do/does/did для эмфазы в утвердительных предложениях.
examples: I do appreciate the effort you put into this project, and I want you to know it.
She does believe that a long-term strategy is essential, because short-term fixes have failed before.
They did implement the strategic initiative last year, and the results speak for themselves.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй продвинутые linking words для логической связности.
examples: Our team has implemented a comprehensive strategic initiative. Nevertheless, we still need to address several long-term challenges.
The company invested in new technology. Consequently, it developed innovative solutions that transformed the market.
She completed the certification in project management. Furthermore, she has developed a completely new training programme.
